scope: Every non-zero-value ISIN disclosed across the ten unparseable SPUS N-PORT filings (src/quant/universe/fixtures/sec-spus-nport-unparseable/, accessions 0001387131-21-004867 through 0001387131-23-008965). Zero-valUSD merger-CVR-style rows are out of scope (mirrors parseSpusNportDocuments unidentifiedHoldings treatment) and were never queried.
note: exchCode=US restricts each mapping job to the composite United States listing only (NASDAQ/NYSE consolidated tape), never a foreign/OTC/currency-suffixed listing of the same issuer. A NOT_FOUND status means OpenFIGI returned no exchCode=US composite record for that ISIN as of capturedAt (observed for names later acquired, taken private, spun off, or reincorporated under a new ISIN) — recorded verbatim, never guessed.
